title: Web form locale codes: column default 'en' is not a seeded mas_languages code
description: va_project_master.web_intake_default_locale defaults to 'en' (model and migration f2a9c4d7e1b3) but flask seed run creates mas_languages codes 'english', 'hindi', ... (app/commands/seed.py). Consequences on every seeded deployment: (1) the form-options resolver in app/routes/api/organization.py logs 'en is not an active language' and falls back to the first active code, so on dev every project's web form opens with locale='assamese'; (2) the projects admin panel now shows 'en (inactive)' and blocks Save until an admin picks an active code. Deeper question: the WHO VA web component's locale attribute expects instrument locale codes ('English (en)' in the bundle), not mas_languages codes, which exist for narration-language alias mapping. Decide: either seed short locale codes / add a locale_code column on mas_languages that the resolver serves, or map at the endpoint. Domain decision, not for an agent to take.
design: Decided 2026-09-19 with the owner: 'en' is the system default web-form language on every project and is always available; a project ADDS languages from the set the bundled instrument actually has translations for (an explicit registry in Python, asserted against the bundle by a test), not from mas_languages; the interviewer picks a working language on the intake page, remembered in the browser (localStorage, last choice wins), falling back to 'en' when the remembered code is not in the project's list. Narration languages stay on mas_languages: they describe the recording, not the screen. No migration.
close_reason: en is default everywhere; project adds instrument-translated locales; browser remembers the interviewer's choice. Suite 1,464 passed.

title: Test that every registered route carries an auth decorator or is allowlisted
description: Walk app.url_map at runtime; fail on any endpoint whose view is not wrapped by role_required/login_required and not on an explicit allowlist. See .tasks/auth-decorator-followups.md item 1.

title: PII field registry fails open for non-WHO form types; PII cache never invalidates
description: Fail closed: a form type whose PII set is unconfirmed (no is_pii row on a field the form owns) has whole payload redacted for no-PII viewers and carries a standing admin warning. Cache keyed on max(updated_at)+count of mas_field_display_config. See .tasks/pii-registry-fails-open-for-non-who-forms.md

title: project_pi role predicate: use an EXISTS check, prove order independence
description: app/decorators/role_required.py gates project_pi with bool(u.get_project_pi_projects()), which fetches every PI project id; .tasks/auth-decorator-followups.md item 3 worried that reordering role_required('admin','project_pi') arguments makes that query unconditional. Reading the code, is_admin() also queries (an EXISTS), so every predicate costs one statement and the ordering concern is about cost class, not correctness. Fix: add VaUsers.is_project_pi() as an EXISTS with the same conditions (active grant, project scope, active project via org_grant_service.active_project_condition) and use it in the predicate; add a test that the decision for admin, PI and neither is identical under both argument orders and that each order issues at most one SELECT per listed role; correct the task file.
close_reason: is_project_pi EXISTS predicate; order independence and cost class proven; suite 1,469 passed

title: Projects panel inputs for the four web_intake_* form-option fields
description: The admin PUT validates web_intake_default_locale, web_intake_available_locales, web_intake_narration_languages and web_intake_show_guidance (docs/policy/va-web-form-options.md) but app/templates/admin/panels/projects.html has no inputs for them, so an admin cannot set them without calling the API by hand. Add the DOM plus read/write JS, drawing the language list from /admin/api/languages, and let the project POST accept the same four fields via the shared validator.
close_reason: Projects panel reads and writes the four web_intake_* fields; POST accepts them; full suite 1,453 passed

title: Form types are DigitVA layers on the standard WHO instrument; intake resolves the base instrument
description: form-options serves instrument_code per form type (WHO_2022_VA for every WHO_2022_VA* layer); intake template keys the bundled instrument on it so WHO_2022_VA_SOCIAL renders. Policy records the layer model.

title: Closed projects revoke every grant scope in both resolution mechanisms
description: Decision: a project with project_status != active resolves no grant of any scope (project, project_site, org_unit) for non-admin roles; grants stay stored so reopening restores them. Apply in org_grant_service.project_wide_grant_exists and VaUsers._get_granted_project_ids / _expand_project_ids_to_active_pairs. See .tasks/closed-project-grant-revocation.md

title: form-options endpoint: per-project tier-2 options for the VA web form
description: GET /api/v1/organization/<project_id>/form-options per docs/policy/va-web-form-options.md. Stores default locale, available locales, narration languages, show_guidance on va_project_master (migration); derives form_types from map_project_site_odk. Intake template stops hardcoding locale='en' and sets the instrument explicitly by form_type_code.
